cases.explain: «тревожные мысли» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: “Therefore my thoughts answer me, even by reason of my haste that is in me.

cases.explain: «железного оружия» — after the preposition «от», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: He will flee from the iron weapon. The bronze arrow will strike him through.

cases.explain: «Кромешная тьма» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: All darkness is laid up for his treasures. An unfanned fire will devour him. It will consume that which is left in his tent.
